worldcombat.skill.sketch.summary: Permanently replace Sketch’s slot with a target's or ally's recent move. Known non-Pokémon attacks are translated into corresponding moves.
worldcombat.skill.sketch.use.0: Permanently learn a target's or ally's move
worldcombat.skill.sketch.use.1: Copy a rare set-up or recovery
worldcombat.skill.sketch.use.2: Put a heavy attack into your own move set
worldcombat.skill.sketch.description.0: Observe any demonstrator within %1$s blocks (enemy or ally) for %2$s; the move to be sketched is shown and locked during the windup, so a later switch by the target does not change the result.
worldcombat.skill.sketch.description.1: Only implemented, sketchable moves you do not already know are copied. It cannot fire without a readable recent action, outside the memory window, or when the line of sight is broken. Moves the native catalogue marks noSketch, and Sketch itself, cannot be learned.
worldcombat.skill.sketch.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sketch.preference.ai.p: On: the companion may sketch a worthwhile move on its own and permanently rewrite the slot. Off (default): it never changes the slot by itself; only a player-cast Sketch learns.
worldcombat.skill.sketch.preference.ai.m: Damaging moves at or above this power rank higher (status moves are exempt). It only affects ranking and never blocks sketching a target the player chose.
Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of drawing. Larger values sketch from further away.
worldcombat.skill.sketch.preference.ai.l: When on, the user may leave its post to sketch under a Hold order; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
worldcombat.skill.sketch.world: A move the target used in the last %1$s seconds that is implemented, sketchable and not yet known is permanently written into Sketch’s slot with full PP. A known native attack from a non-Pokémon is translated: melee→Tackle, sting→Poison Sting, ram→Headbutt, mace→Slam, arrow→Poison Sting, trident→Pin Missile, fireball→Ember, sonic boom→Sonic Boom, indirect magic→Psybeam. Unlisted attacks cannot be sketched.
